content: Trax/FORM differentiates on on-device IR, AR continuous shelf scan, billions-image SKU library, share-of-shelf/competitive analytics, next-best-action task lists, HQ dashboards, price detection, photo stitching. Pensa differentiates on Vision AI shelf digitization, auto planogram from photos, promo/signage audit, per-store shelf optimization recommendations, workflow automation into existing WFM/SFA stacks.
